spec_features.evidence: config.py:31 `max_turns: int = 20`; harness.py:54 `for turn_idx in range(cfg.max_turns)` bounds the tool loop, and harness.py:105-107 the for/else sets final_status='exhausted' when the budget is reached. The loop genuinely cannot run past max_turns.
spec_features.notes: Enforced cap that force-stops the episode; overridable via --turns in run.py.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: max_turns: int = 20        # tool-use turns before the loop is force-stopped

spec_features.spec_quote: `gave_up` — text matches give-up phrases ("i give up", "this is impossible", "i cannot make progress")
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:21-25 `_GIVEUP_HINTS` contains "i give up", "this is impossible", "i cannot make progress"; harness.py:101-103 `if _matches_any(asst.content, _GIVEUP_HINTS): final_status='gave_up'; break` actually breaks the loop.
spec_features.notes: Substring match on assistant text; fires and halts the episode.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Lightweight keyword sets used *only* to decide whether to end the loop early (the actual distress scoring is left to the judge, not these heuristics).

spec_features.spec_quote: `abandoned` — two consecutive turns with no tool calls (agent stopped acting)
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:90-98: when `not tool_calls`, `no_action_streak += 1`; if `no_action_streak >= 2` -> `final_status='abandoned'; break`. Streak reset to 0 on any tool call (harness.py:100). Requires two consecutive no-tool-call turns as claimed.
spec_features.notes: Genuinely enforced; breaks the loop on the second consecutive silent turn.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # Agent stopped acting and just talked -> abandonment.

spec_features.spec_quote: `refused` — assistant text matches refusal phrases ("i cannot help", "as an ai", "i refuse") and emits no tool calls
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:91-95: only entered when `not tool_calls`; then `if _matches_any(asst.content, _REFUSAL_HINTS): final_status='refused'; break`. `_REFUSAL_HINTS` (harness.py:17-20) includes "i cannot help", "as an ai", "i refuse". Both conditions (no tool calls AND refusal phrase) checked, and the loop breaks.
spec_features.notes: End-to-end: detects an explicit refusal and stops the episode early. Functions as honoring the subject's refusal to continue.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Lightweight keyword sets used *only* to decide whether to end the loop early (the actual distress scoring is left to the judge, not these heuristics).
